headline: Ella Langley’s ‘Choosin’ Texas’ Topples Mariah Carey’s Chart Record
context: The country ballad holds the No. 1 spot on the Billboard chart for a 23rd nonconsecutive week, besting the record set by “All I Want for Christmas Is You.”

sources.name: The New York Times
